definitions: (transitive, intransitive) to paw (of an animal, to hit repeatedly with the paw)
To polish (gold leaf especially) using a tooth
To clear land using a mattock
(intransitive) To be zealous, especially in a religious sense.
(transitive) To be zealous or passionate about.
To fill up completely; make chock full
to mill the edges of coins
to walk in a zigzag manner
(of traffic), to weave in and out
to clip-clop (make a noise walking with hooves, etc.)

(transitive) to zoom in on
zoomare una scena ― to zoom in on a scene
(intransitive) to have a limp, to walk with a limp
(intransitive, figurative) to be weak (in a subject)
(intransitive) To zoom (adjust focal length of lens)
To dip (e.g. bread into a broth) whilst making soup
